label: Anthropic
description: Anthropic API key + Claude Code coding agent for Settings → LLMs. Install from Store → Gateways, then enable to show Anthropic under Providers & Keys and Claude Code under Coding Agents.

settings.sections.title: Anthropic prompt caching
settings.sections.description: Bill-discount cache_control markers on API calls. Separate from Ducky's freeze prefix (works for all providers).

properties.label: Enable Anthropic cache markers
properties.description: Sends Anthropic cache_control on the stable system prefix, tools, and latest message.

properties.label: Extended cache TTL (1h)
properties.description: Uses Anthropic's 1-hour ephemeral cache instead of the default 5-minute window.

steps.title: Open Anthropic
steps.body: Press the Anthropic row in this table. The page slides open so you can paste a key or use Claude Code.

steps.title: API key or Claude Code
steps.body: Paste your Anthropic API key here to use Claude in Ducky chats. No key? Skip this and use Claude Code on this same slide.

steps.title: Test & Save
steps.body: Press Test & Save after you paste a key. Using Claude Code without a key? Press Skip.

steps.title: IDE / MCP connection
steps.body: IDE / MCP wires UEFN tools and Ducky skills into Claude globally (every project). Apply once, then Test. Green check = up to date.

steps.title: Apply connection
steps.body: Press Apply (or Re-apply) so UEFN MCP and Ducky skills land in Claude. Then Test — a green check means connected.

steps.title: Claude Code
steps.body: Claude Code is Anthropic's coding agent. Detect finds the CLI (often under .local\bin). Keep it on to pick Claude Code in chat.

steps.title: Detect CLI
steps.body: Press Detect to find Claude Code on this machine. Leave the toggle on so it appears in the chat picker.

steps.title: Log in here
steps.body: This is the Claude Code login row. Press Log in — click the sign-in link in the window, then paste the code. A Claude Login tab appears in the terminal list and closes when you cancel or finish. Never paste a login code in chat.

steps.title: Anthropic prompt caching
steps.body: Cache markers discount repeated Anthropic prefixes. Extended TTL keeps that cache for an hour — leave both on unless you have a reason not to.

steps.title: Back
steps.body: Press Back to return to the provider list.

nodes.label: Anthropic complete
nodes.description: One-shot prompt through the Anthropic gateway. Writes text onto the run.

templates.label: Anthropic complete
templates.description: Chat prompt through Anthropic, then finish.
